Container.Name: zap2xml
Container.Overview: Grabs TV guide data from tvlistings.gracenote.com (grid-affiliates, affiliate id orbebb) and writes an XMLTV file to /data on a refresh loop. Log in with a TV Listings account, or skip the account and give a provider headend id + ZIP code. Plex, Emby and Jellyfin can read the file directly or pull it from the built-in web server on port 8080. Output: /mnt/user/appdata/zap2xml/xmltv.xml

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Holds xmltv.xml and the download cache. Point Plex/Emby/Jellyfin at xmltv.xml in here.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Built-in web server serving xmltv.xml (set ENABLE_HTTP=false to turn off).

Config.Name: ZIP code
Config.Description: Postal code of your provider, e.g. 98101. Needed unless you log in.

Config.Name: Lineup / headend id
Config.Description: Provider headend id from the grid page, e.g. WA46626. Needed unless you log in.

Config.Name: Username (optional)
Config.Description: TV Listings account email. Leave blank to use lineup id + ZIP instead.

Config.Name: Output file
Config.Description: Full path of the XMLTV file to write. Must stay inside /data to persist.

Config.Name: Affiliate id
Config.Description: Gracenote affiliate id from the grid URL (?aid=). Leave at orbebb unless you know better.

Config.Name: Grab options
Config.Description: zap2xml.pl flags: -a all channels, -d N days, -I icons, -D program details (slower), -U UTF-8.

Config.Name: HTTP port (inside container)
Config.Description: Port the built-in server listens on inside the container. Must match the container side of the Web port mapping.

Config.Name: Serve over HTTP
Config.Description: true/false - run the built-in web server.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id owning the output files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id owning the output files.
